items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’ve worked off and on for a few years with Lena Horne

ctx.x: Yeah, it sure did. But working with Brubeck and the whole Brubeck clan was just absolutely delightful. And then, after that, it’s been very notable. I’ve worked off and on for a few years with Lena Horne, who is one of my favorite all-time people in the world, not only just as an entertainer, but as a person, I love her. I’ve worked with Gerry Mulligan off and on for a couple of years, fascinating experience, I really dig Gerry. You know we’ve been good, close friends for a number of years and he was always…
your statement, it’s quick. And once again it was the machine, it had to be like that. Otherwise you could have 18 anarchists up there on stage.
